# Recorded on a MacBook Pro M1 Pro on v393216 (1.4.1), with no prewarm lists present (the bundled list was empty, so everything was built on the spot), over one player's playthrough of the whole game between 29 October and 5 November 2026, across several builds of main and of controller branches on it (no shader or pipeline changes of their own): this device's pso_user.tsv in the order it was recorded.

# 26,678 rows: 17,825 shaders, 8,818 render and 35 compute pipelines, every shader key in shader_map.tsv. Two rows of the recording were left out: a geometry shader's kernel (653761faae9ece8c_bg1) and its reader (_bgv), which the prewarm counts as not in the shader map.
